summary.$description: The betslip footer's totals — a key-value list (label left, value right) that sits above the Place-bet button. Three layouts share the same rows: Single (total stake · possible win), Combo (a turbo-combo multiplier row + total-odds with live movement + possible win, plus a max-bet hint), System (a System-Combination select, then total-odds / possible-win as ranges). The reusable part Summary owns is the ROW: `.summary__row` (label + value), with `--win` (positive/green value), `--turbo` (active/orange value with the rocket glyph), and an optional info icon on the label (opens a Tooltip). Values are plain text, a range, or the Odds component (total-odds movement, prev-left). Everything else in a footer — the stake field (Input + a Max chip), the System-Combination Select, the Odds, the hint text — is composed from its own component; Summary does not restyle them.

blockGap.$description: 12px between the footer's blocks (stake field / hint / row list).

rowGap.$description: 12px min gap between a row's label and value.

label.$description: 14px regular — the row label (Total bet amount, Possible win…).

labelGap.$description: 4px between the label text and its optional info icon.

value.$description: 14px bold, tabular-nums — the totals value. Bold (weight.bold) so the money reads as the emphasised figure of the row.

valueColor.$description: Default value colour (total stake, total odds).

size.$description: 16px info icon (ui/info-outline) on a row label — opens the Tooltip (e.g. why total odds is a range).

color.$description: Muted grey — chrome, not a warning (unlike the bet card's gold settlement info).

type.$description: 12px — the 'Potential max bet $2717, Deposit Now to bet higher' line (with an inline link).
